root_idea.summary: The root centers on entering, penetrating, or passing within.
root_idea.development: From physical entry, the lexicon develops senses of insertion, intermixture, inwardness, intrusion, and a hidden defect or foreign element.

senses.definition: To enter, go into, or come within a place or space.
senses.usage_conditions: The ordinary intransitive sense; the destination may be expressed directly or through a preposition, and the verb may describe entering a physical place or realm.

senses.definition: To enter into, join, or become included in a community, religion, affair, or state.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of coming within a social, religious, practical, or otherwise defined domain, including becoming part of a group or undertaking.

senses.definition: To go in to a woman sexually; to have sexual intercourse.
senses.usage_conditions: A conventional euphemistic construction, especially دَخَلَ بِـ or دَخَلَ عَلَى, whose meaning is determined by the marital or sexual context.

senses.definition: To cause someone or something to enter; to bring, put, introduce, or admit within.
senses.usage_conditions: The causative counterpart of Form I, used transitively for bringing a person or thing into a place, state, or domain; passive occurrences mean “be admitted” or “be made to enter.”
An active participle used substantivally for entrants or those who enter a place or domain.

senses.definition: Deceit, guile, or circumvention used covertly between people.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction concerning oaths, it denotes using them as a concealed means of deception or bad faith between parties.

senses.definition: A place into which one may enter; an entrance or refuge.
senses.usage_conditions: A lexicalized place noun in the Quranic reading of 9:57, describing a possible place of concealment or entry.

senses.definition: An entrance, entry, or admission into a place or condition.
senses.usage_conditions: A noun associated with entering or causing entry; Quranic usage includes an honorable or agreeable entry and an entrance into a desired destination. The form has recognized reading variation in some occurrences.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Income, revenue, or profit that comes in or accrues.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of returns from property, land, houses, palms, or merchandise; contrasted with expenditure or outgoings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For parts or things to enter into one another and become intermixed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction describing mutual interpenetration, such as stars or other things becoming confused together.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come upon, overtake, or invade someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of night or another circumstance coming upon a person; the same unit also records grammatical preposing uses that are not separate lexical meanings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a suspicion, adverse impression, or evil opinion to enter the mind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative inward-entry construction expressing the onset of doubt or distrust.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be intrinsically unsound, corrupt, or defective.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to the intellect, body, grounds for respect, or an affair or state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be eaten or damaged by worms or similar pests.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of grain or food that has become infested.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be led unknowingly into a mistake or error concerning something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The error results from a preconceived idea or mistaken assumption.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put dates into a palm-leaf receptacle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form II usage concerning the preparation of dates.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter with another into a place or affair; to associate or mix closely with people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe involvement in another’s affairs, familiar social intercourse, conversation, or intimacy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For an unsoundness or corruption to permeate and mingle with someone’s intellect or body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form III construction likening corruption to something entering into and commingling with its object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring an evil charge against people or burden them with an objectionable accusation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative causative use in which an injurious allegation is brought upon a group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To intermix, intermingle, or become confused; for parts to enter into one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used of compactness or contraction, interlocking joints, mixed dialects, and confused affairs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For something to creep into the mind and produce distress or disquietude.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative transitive construction describing an emotion or concern arising from an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To encroach upon or press in on someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare, tentatively attested Form VIII usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wish, desire, request, or ask to enter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X desiderative or seeking construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter a covert or concealed place while lying in wait.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person hiding in a thicket or other cover in order to shoot or cast at game.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A defect, disease, corruption, or unsoundness; something that compromises soundness or reputation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to intellect, body, lineage or claims to respect, and affairs; the sense may extend to a blemish or a thing arousing suspicion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A species of millet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plant-name, synonymous with جَاوَرْسٌ and also recorded with another vocalization.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An intrusive element that enters into something without belonging to it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression can describe something foreign or adventitious within a thing or arrangement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Internal rottenness in a palm tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural usage describing decay within the tree.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Leanness or emaciation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily condition associated lexically with something having been entered or affected internally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: People who claim relationship to a group without belonging to it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective or quasi-plural designation for persons falsely asserting lineage or affiliation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tangled, luxuriant, dense trees or growth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to vegetation whose abundance and interweaving make it dense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place in which bees deposit their honey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized place noun referring to a bees’ honey-depositing site.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The night or ceremony of conducting a bride to her husband.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional social term connected with the consummation of marriage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person’s inward or intrinsic state, intentions, conduct, circumstances, mind, or secret.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the inner reality of an affair or person, including the whole underlying state of a matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mixture of colours within a colour.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive term for coloration containing another colour.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A close companion, confidant, or intimate who enters into another’s affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May denote a special friend, trusted associate, or person admitted into the private affairs of another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Persons who enter among a people without belonging to them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A contrasting use for lower-status outsiders or intruders among a group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An earwig or a certain worm.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A zoological designation with variant identifications in the lexical tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A portion of flesh or fat situated within other flesh.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical term for flesh embedded in or surrounded by flesh.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A practice of putting a camel that has drunk among camels that have not, or returning camels to water for further drinking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical term in watering camels, with several recorded procedural variations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The forelocks of a horse, regarded as entering or interlacing with one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized equine term based on the interlocking appearance of the hair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A guest, especially one placed under a person’s protection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The protective or hospitable sense is conventional in expressions of seeking refuge or patronage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stranger or adventive resident living among people to whom he is not related.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person who has entered or remains within a group without belonging to it; it may also be applied to a female.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A subject introduced into a discourse by digression or related association rather than belonging to its proper subject matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical figurative use for an adventitious topic.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A word introduced into Arabic that is not indigenous to the language.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A linguistic term for an adventitious or borrowed word.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A horse inserted between two other horses in a race for a wager.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized racing term for an intervening horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An animal brought up and fed in or near a house or tent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially a gazelle or similar animal reared domestically and treated as a household animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A horse fed exclusively on fodder, or a horse belonging to a specified racing class.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized equine usage with more than one recorded application.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain traditional game of the Arabs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A culture-specific lexical item.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Herbage growing among the stems or branches of trees in a tangled state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The growth is difficult or impossible to graze because it is inserted among the trees.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Feathers inserted between the outer and inner layers of a bird’s plumage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These interstitial feathers are described as especially good because they are protected from the sun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Flesh or muscle lying within sinews, intermixed with other flesh, or cleaving to bone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical term for compact or interwoven flesh.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person compact or contracted in body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive bodily epithet explained as having one portion of the body inserted into another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small bird that enters or lives among dense trees, caves, houses, or tents.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A zoological term with descriptions of its size, colouring, habitat, and seasonal behaviour.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who enters frequently or habitually.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive active-participial description of repeated entry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An earwig or similar small creature that enters the ear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantival use of the active participle in a zoological expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Internal or inward; lying within.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally of a disease, love, or another inward quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The interior or inside of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive noun opposed to the exterior; it is normally used with a preposition when expressing location.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The inner part or extremity of a waist-wrapper next to the body; by extension, the bodily region beneath it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized clothing and anatomical expression with variant explanations in the lexicon.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A low or depressed part of the ground serving as a covert.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place-name for a hollow or concealed area, especially one useful for hiding.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Bad pieces of money concealed or mixed among good pieces.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A commercial figurative use for defective items inserted among sound ones.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woven palm-leaf container in which fresh or ripe dates are placed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A receptacle term with variant forms and plurals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An entrance, ingress, or place of entry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place noun for the access point of a house or other location; related figurative uses are recorded separately.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A way of acting or a means of attaining or doing something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of an entrance as a route or means, including a means of attaining good.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A time of entrance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A less common temporal use of the place-or-time noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Base-born, ignoble, or of suspected or adopted lineage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative specialization connected with being introduced among people to whom one is not related or claiming a false father.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An instrument by which one enters, such as a key.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical instrumental noun reported in the philosophical and medical lexicographic tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wife or woman with whom a man has had intercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial euphemism for the woman to whom a man has gone in, whether lawfully or unlawfully in the broad lexical explanation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Unsound in intellect, body, or grounds for respect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial description of someone internally affected by a defect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Emaciated or lean.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily specialization of the passive participle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Eaten or damaged by worms or similar pests.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to grain or food that has been internally affected.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A palm tree rotten within.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural collocation describing internal decay.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Compact, firm, or strongly interlocked in bodily make.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a she-camel or a man whose bodily parts are closely integrated.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who intrudes into affairs or puts himself to trouble to enter into them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A participial description of meddling or intrusive involvement in matters belonging to others.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Entry and its distinct figurative branches are covered.
Inclusion in a religion or affair is covered.
Coming upon or invading is covered; the preposition example is grammatical.
Entry of suspicion into the mind is covered.
Unsoundness in person or affair is covered.
Being led into error is covered.
Putting dates into a container is covered.
Association, involvement, and commingled corruption are covered.
Causative entry, insertion, and Quran-attested entry are covered.
Bringing an evil charge is covered.
Mutual intermixture and interlocking are covered.
Something entering the mind and causing distress is covered.
Desiring or asking to enter is covered.
Entering covertly to lie in wait is covered.
Disease, defect, and suspicion-producing fault are covered.
Intrusive foreign element and corrupt condition are covered.
Quran-attested deceit is represented under the Quranic noun.
False claims of relationship are covered.
Dense or tangled trees are covered.
Intrinsic corruption is covered by the defect branch.
Inner state, intention, and secret are covered.
Confidant or intimate involved in affairs is covered.
Outsiders entering among a people are covered.
Earwig or worm designation is covered.
Adventive stranger among a people is covered.
Adventitious word in the language is covered.
Domestic animal and specialized horse senses are covered.
Tangled herbage among trees is covered.
Intermixed or embedded flesh is covered.
Small intrusive or tree-dwelling bird is covered.
Singular noun relation adds no separate lexical branch.
Frequent or habitual entry is covered.
Active participle and zoological substantival use are covered.
Internal or inward epithet is covered.
Inner part of the waist-wrapper and body region are covered.
Defective money concealed among good pieces is covered.
Figurative way or means is covered.
Entry, admission, and place-or-time noun are covered under the Quranic form.
Ignoble or suspected lineage is covered separately.
Quranic place of entry is covered.
Woman with whom intercourse has occurred is covered.

cautions: The Quranic noun دَخَلٌ is restricted here to its explicitly attested sense of covert deceit; other defect, corruption, and foreign-element senses remain Classical Arabic meanings.
The Form I sexual sense is construction-specific and should not be inferred from ordinary physical-entry occurrences.
Some rare zoological, agricultural, and technical senses are attributed or variant in the lexical evidence but are retained because they state genuine lexical uses.
